description: Source code for the TbCheckRelationNode class, a rule engine component in Thingsboard that checks for the presence of relations between entities based on configuration.

classes.name: TbCheckRelationNode
classes.description: A rule engine node that checks for the presence of a relation between entities based on configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, setting up configuration and resolving single entity ID if needed.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, performing relation checks based on configuration.

methods.name: processSingle
methods.description: Checks relation presence between the message originator and a single specified entity.

methods.name: processList
methods.description: Checks for relations from or to the message originator, returning true if any exist.

methods.name: isEmptyList
methods.description: Determines if the list of relations is empty, returning false if empty, true otherwise.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrade from version 0 to newer versions.
